string-array.name: privacy_bodies
string-array.item: All your books, notes, and settings are stored exclusively on your device using local storage or the device\'s local filesystem. No account is required.
We do not use any analytics services, crash reporters, or advertising SDKs.
Biblioteka does not request any runtime Android permission. Backups are written to the app\'s private cache and shared only when you explicitly tap Share.
Biblioteka is fully open source. You can inspect all code on GitHub to verify these claims.
Privacy questions? Open an issue on GitHub or contact the developer directly at biblioteka@damiankokot.eu.
